bundle.shortDescription: Blur opted-out faces in event photos, offline.
bundle.longDescription: Blurlist lets schools, camps and youth nonprofits load an opt-out roster with one reference photo each, then finds and blurs those faces across a whole event folder on the computer, before anything is uploaded. Uncertain matches go to a review pile instead of being guessed, and every exported photo has its metadata removed.
